items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Cause me and Oak, we're always like one family down here, see?

ctx.x: You just wish to hire me. Cause you go to him, he gonna tell you the same thing. Somebody you been hired for, so what's happened? He'll call you, what's the so and so, what's happened? Just like, just like when, when one of the bass players get fired out of the band, and they call me up, I call him, I call him, what's the matter with you? Just like, one or two, he's gonna fire out the band, what's the matter to? You know where he'll want me to play. Well he got to tell me, if he don't, he's gonna tell me, just…
